Immutable Diagram Model - shared by canvas, agents, history, and storage
|-- Diagram: repository-independent value [diagram.ts]
|   |-- Identity
|   |   |-- diagramId: stable service identity
|   |   |-- revisionId: service revision identity
|   |   `-- id + revision: local canvas key + nonnegative content revision
|   |-- content: ASCII + SHA-256 + content revisionId + versioned structure
|   |-- sourceContext: contentHash + mappings + evidence + optional source binding
|   |   |-- mapping.entityId + sourceRangeIndex -> evidence entry -> source range
|   |   |   `-- Range records path, line interval, and original source lines
|   |   |-- Binding: sourceId + repositoryIdentity + corpus + domainProfileId
|   |   |   |-- source-code -> git-worktree
|   |   |   `-- document -> filesystem-documents
|   |   `-- diagramSource(): read-only joins for entries, selection, and search
|   `-- Optional highlights and jumps
|-- Content interpretation [diagramContent.ts, diagramContentNodes.ts]
|   |-- buildDiagramContent(ascii, revisionId, kind, version)
|   |   |-- At most 20000 printable ASCII characters; LF newlines
|   |   |-- Empty text rejected except a blank rectangular diagram placeholder
|   |   `-- Rebuild uses the stored parser version to reproduce structure and IDs
|   |-- kind = tree
|   |   |-- New content: ascii-tree-2; ascii-tree-1 remains supported
|   |   |-- parseAsciiTree -> shared parseDiagram interpreter
|   |   |   `-- Tree dialect; zero tolerances; separate continuations; no repairs
|   |   |-- Stores rootIds and nodes with parentId, childIds, and foldRanges
|   |   |-- Node ID = content revisionId + ASCII hash + line number
|   |   `-- Collapsing nodes hides their fold ranges; unknown IDs are stale
|   |-- kind = diagram
|   |   |-- ascii-graph-1 -> parseAsciiGraph
|   |   |   |-- Text boxes + containment + wires -> boxes, edges, rootIds
|   |   |   `-- Content nodes project boxes into labels, hierarchy, and line spans
|   |   |-- No parserVersion -> legacy parseDiagram forever
|   |   |   `-- Mixed dialect; separate continuations; no repairs
|   |   `-- Derived nodes are frozen and cached by content object in a WeakMap
|   `-- Parser pinning protects stored nodeRefs from changed ID derivation
|-- Revision lifecycle [diagramRevision.ts, diagramRevisionEditor.ts]
|   |-- createDiagram(input) -> prepareCreate -> issue immutable revision
|   |-- reviseDiagram(base, edit) -> prepareEdit
|   |   |-- source-mappings: expectedContentHash must match current ASCII hash
|   |   |-- patch / patches: apply line-range edits and optional correspondence
|   |   |-- replace: construct content at revision + 1
|   |   |   `-- Rebase previous jumps and highlights; optionally retain mappings
|   |   |-- highlights / jumps: validate replacement annotations
|   |   `-- Same diagram object -> return base; otherwise issue child revision
|   |-- deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources)
|   |   `-- Reuse identities only from supplied revisions of the same diagram
|   |       `-- Each claimed ref must select exactly one output node by line
|   |-- issueDiagramRevision
|   |   |-- Preserve diagramId; revisions carry optional parentId
|   |   |-- nodeRefs: revision-scoped content node ID -> logical node identity
|   |   |   |-- Explicit derived identity -> reuse it
|   |   |   |-- Proven old-to-new correspondence -> inherit base logical identity
|   |   |   `-- Otherwise -> allocate a new node UUID
|   |   `-- Deep-freeze record and diagram payload; validate diagram
|   `-- resolve(contextId, diagramId)
|       `-- Context binding -> revision -> cloned view using logical node IDs
|           `-- Remaps parent/child links and active jump source nodes too
|-- Edit integrity and continuity
|   |-- validateDiagram [diagram.ts]
|   |   |-- Require service identities; older identity-less stores need migration
|   |   |-- Rebuild canonical content with pinned parser; require exact equality
|   |   |-- Require sourceContext.contentHash = SHA-256(content.ascii)
|   |   `-- Validate binding, annotations, mapping geometry, evidence, and joins
|   |-- Node correspondence [diagramRevisionEditor.ts]
|   |   |-- Automatic whole-content matching requires identical ASCII and kind
|   |   |   `-- Match unique node by line, columns, and label
|   |   |-- Explicit claim: existing logical ref -> one output node at a line
|   |   `-- Reject conflicting claims or multiple identities claiming one node
|   |-- Scoped replacement [diagramSubtreeEdit.ts]
|   |   |-- Resolve revision-pinned roots; reject stale or noncontiguous subtrees
|   |   |-- Single subtree, multiple contiguous, or multiple disjoint ranges
|   |   |   `-- Reject overlaps; contiguous mode permits only blank gaps
|   |   `-- Candidate supplies full ASCII context
|   |       `-- Preserve every line outside selected ranges exactly -> patches
|   `-- merge(baseline, current, proposed) [diagramRevisionEditor.ts]
|       `-- Any baseline/current binding change -> MERGE_REQUIRED
|           `-- Automatic three-way merge is not implemented
`-- Consumers and storage boundaries
    |-- Canvas connections [diagramConnection.ts]
    |   |-- Source: content-node anchor; target: content-node or box anchor
    |   |-- Content anchor pins displayNodeId + contentNodeId + content revisionId
    |   |-- Strict validation requires a current node; bulk loading permits stale revisions
    |   `-- reconcileConnections(before, after, edges, nodeIds)
    |       |-- Missing endpoint box -> remove incident edge
    |       |-- Proven node mapping -> update node ID and content revisionId
    |       |-- Identical ASCII and kind -> positional fallback can rebase anchor
    |       `-- Changed content without correspondence -> leave anchor stale
    `-- Runtime revision store [diagramRevisionStore.ts]
        |-- Domain create/revise/derive operations work without the store
        |-- import: require a nonempty, unique logical ref for every content node
        |-- retain: register revision -> return retained diagram and revision
        |-- get / list: retrieve revisions and frozen identity/parent summaries
        `-- Durable adapters flush retained revisions before publishing bindings
